operatorProperties.code:
def process(topThreeIdTheftReports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = topThreeIdTheftReports.copy()

    # The table's true header is at row index 1
    header = df.iloc[1].tolist()  # ['Theft Type','Year','# of Reports']
    body = df.iloc[2:].copy()
    body.columns = header

    # In this CSV, the first column actually holds the year values (as strings),
    # the second column holds the identity theft category.
    out = pd.DataFrame({
        'Year': pd.to_numeric(body['Theft Type'], errors='coerce'),
        'Theft Type': body['Year'].astype(str),
        '# of Reports': pd.to_numeric(
            body['# of Reports'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False),
            errors='coerce'
        )
    })

    out = out.dropna(subset=['Year', 'Theft Type', '# of Reports']).copy()
    out['Year'] = out['Year'].astype(int)
    out['Theft Type'] = out['Theft Type'].str.strip()

    # Keep only the requested window (helps ignore any stray non-year rows)
    out = out[(out['Year'] >= 2020) & (out['Year'] <= 2024)].copy()

    return out.sort_values(['Theft Type', 'Year']).reset_index(drop=True)

operatorProperties.code:
def process(cleanTopThreeIdTheftReports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = cleanTopThreeIdTheftReports.copy()

    # Use 2020 as baseline and 2024 as end; compute relative growth (pct change)
    pivot = df.pivot_table(index='Theft Type', columns='Year', values='# of Reports', aggfunc='sum')

    needed_years = [2020, 2024]
    for y in needed_years:
        if y not in pivot.columns:
            pivot[y] = pd.NA

    out = pivot[needed_years].rename(columns={2020: 'reports2020', 2024: 'reports2024'}).reset_index()

    out['relative_growth'] = (out['reports2024'] - out['reports2020']) / out['reports2020']

    # pick max relative growth
    out = out.sort_values('relative_growth', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
    return out
